key_findings: Oxaliplatin enhanced capsaicin-induced TRPV1 currents, calcium, ROS, mitochondrial depolarization, apoptosis and cytokines in rat DRG neurons.
Selenium suppressed these effects and reduced oxaliplatin-induced pain behavior via TRPV1 inhibition.
